variants.name: DeckBracket
variants.collider: box: post; box: beam; box: brace (or one convex hull)

deck_fit.wall_side: +X (post back face against the wall / under the deck edge)
deck_fit.usage: two brackets per SM_ST10_Boardwalk (1.7 x 2.0), beams across its 1.7 m width, placed under its end feet (about 0.25 m from each 2.0 m end); the boardwalk feet sit at beam_top_z. Nothing of the bracket rises above beam_top_z.

variants.notes: Post, beam, brace and 6 square pegs (incl. through-ends on the back) are separate real geometry; beam/peg ends use the end_grain disc.
